description: Gemini-3.6-Flash voice annotations for chavo character-class LoRAs (TTS-AGI/moss-race-loras). id = raw training identifier / HF adapter folder; human_name = display name.

dragonkin.one_sentence_impression: An immensely deep, booming male voice with a rich gravelly resonance that commands quiet authority.
dragonkin.detailed_sentence: Characterized by an exceptionally low pitch, powerful chest resonance, and a slow, measured delivery, this voice carries a subtle raspy texture in its lower register that conveys ancient wisdom and physically imposing scale.
dragonkin.perceived_age: Elderly (60+ or ageless fantasy entity), suggested by the heavy low-end rumble and deliberate, experienced pacing.
dragonkin.register: Very low bass register with steady, controlled intonation and low pitch variation.

timbre_profile.summary: Extremely dark and chest-resonant with a warm, gravelly low-end and booming weight.

dragonkin.distinctive_features: Slow and deliberate pacing with natural pauses; deep, room-shaking bass projection; subtle guttural rasp on sustained vowels.

casting.role: Ancient dragon or elemental stone guardian
casting.direction: Speak with slow, immovable weight and calm, majestic authority.

casting.role: Alien patriarch or planetary warlord
casting.direction: Deliver lines with deep resonance, steady pacing, and absolute confidence.

casting.role: Primordial shadow entity or ominous narrator
casting.direction: Maintain a low, rumbling voice that feels close to the listener's ear.

drake.one_sentence_impression: A deep, soothing male voice with a steady cadence and rich chest resonance that projects calm authority and quiet experience.
drake.detailed_sentence: The voice is a low, warm baritone-bass with strong chest resonance, minimal pitch fluctuation, and a smooth, deliberate delivery that carries a sense of weariness, wisdom, and understated command.
drake.perceived_age: Middle-aged (~40-55), suggested by its deep resonance and calm, seasoned gravitas.
drake.register: Low register (baritone/bass) with controlled, steady pitch movement and deliberate pacing.

timbre_profile.summary: Deep, dark, and highly resonant chest voice with subtle warmth and light textural grit.

drake.distinctive_features: Slow, measured pacing with deliberate pauses, deep chest resonance, and a controlled, unruffled cadence.

casting.role: Grizzled ranger or veteran commander
casting.direction: Speak with quiet authority and weary experience, letting the natural low resonance carry weight without raising your voice.

casting.role: Seasoned space station engineer or starship captain
casting.direction: Deliver reports calmly and methodically, projecting steady composure in critical situations.

casting.role: Reclusive detective or town sheriff
casting.direction: Maintain a low, guarded tone that conveys quiet observation and unspoken history.

doomguard.one_sentence_impression: A monstrously deep, pitch-processed demonic growl with immense sub-bass weight and dark authority.
doomguard.detailed_sentence: This voice sits in an unnaturally low sub-bass register, producing a slow, ponderous delivery laced with guttural gravel, cavernous chest resonance, and a menacing pitch-shifted growl.
doomguard.perceived_age: Ancient / timeless (sounds like an ancient monstrous entity or seasoned demonic lord)
doomguard.register: Extremely low sub-bass register with very rigid pitch control, spoken in a slow, ominous monotone.

timbre_profile.summary: Dark, subterranean, and heavily guttural with massive sub-bass resonance and a rough gravelly edge.

doomguard.distinctive_features: Slow, deliberate pacing with long pauses between clauses and a characteristic throat-clearing vocal fry growl on phrase endings.

casting.role: Demonic warlord or abyssal conqueror
casting.direction: Deliver lines with absolute, terrifying calm and immense weight.

casting.role: Alien leviathan or giant cyborg juggernaut
casting.direction: Speak slowly and deliberately, letting the sub-bass rumble carry the threat.

casting.role: Summoned ancient demon or cursed entity
casting.direction: Project a low, room-shaking threat as if physically towering over the listener.

gnoll.one_sentence_impression: A raw, violent creature vocalization featuring guttural throat snarls and raspy, predatory shrieks.
gnoll.detailed_sentence: This synthetic voice delivers purely feral monster sounds characterized by intense throat distortion, wet air expulsions, and aggressive screeching growls suitable for predatory beasts.
gnoll.perceived_age: Ageless / Mature Beast, suggesting a fully grown, formidable monster.
gnoll.perceived_gender: Masculine / Non-Human, presenting as a heavy, aggressive male monster or genderless beast.
gnoll.register: Low growling pitch with sudden explosive spikes into high raspy screams.

timbre_profile.summary: Extremely throaty and violently rough, dominated by guttural gravel and raw friction with zero clean resonance.

gnoll.distinctive_features: Aggressive wet snarls, explosive screeching bursts, gravelly guttural resonance, and animalistic panting.

casting.role: Feral gnoll pack leader
casting.direction: Deliver uninhibited creature growls and explosive combat shrieks.

casting.role: Carnivorous alien beast
casting.direction: Focus on guttural breathing, snarls, and aggressive predatory vocalizations.

casting.role: Demonic shadow beast
casting.direction: Emphasize wet throat rasp and violent, tortured shrieks.

harpy.one_sentence_impression: A high-pitched, intensely screechy, and raspy voice that sounds like a wicked fantasy hag or harpy squawking dramatically.
harpy.detailed_sentence: This voice is characterized by an extremely bright, shrill falsetto register laced with heavy throat rasp, piercing dynamic shrieks at sentence starts, and a theatrical, erratic cadence reminiscent of a fantasy monster or manic witch.
harpy.perceived_age: Elderly (~60-80), suggested by the raspy friction, crackling vocal texture, and dramatic crone-like cadence.
harpy.register: Very high pitch sitting predominantly in screeching falsetto with wide, exaggerated pitch swings and wild dynamic bursts.

timbre_profile.summary: Piercingly bright and intensely rough, dominated by extreme throat rasp, falsetto strain, and almost zero chest resonance.

harpy.distinctive_features: Starts sentences with a high-pitched scream or shriek, features intense vocal friction, manic theatrical rhythm, sharp sibilance, and exaggerated pitch contour.

casting.role: Wicked Hag / Village Witch
casting.direction: Deliver lines with manic energy, accentuating the gravelly rasps and shrill screeching peaks.

casting.role: Cursed Monster / Harpy
casting.direction: Project wild, unpredictable pitch swings and aggressive vocal fry to terrify the listener.

casting.role: Over-the-top Villainous Minion
casting.direction: Play up the squawking, theatrical drama with bright, cartoonish intensity.

kobold.one_sentence_impression: A high-pitched, highly constricted creature voice with raspy sibilance and manic energy.
kobold.detailed_sentence: This voice is characterized by an elevated vocal register, intense throat constriction, and a dry, raspy texture that produces a pinched, squeaky, and frantic fantasy minion sound without any chest resonance.
kobold.perceived_age: Ageless small creature (conveys a manic, elderly or small-statured fantasy entity)
kobold.register: High register with sharp, erratic pitch movement and constricted head voice tone.

timbre_profile.summary: A thin, sharp, and throat-constricted creature timbre dominated by rasp and high pitch.

kobold.distinctive_features: Squeaky vocal fry, tight pharyngeal constriction, eager and rushed rhythm, and sharp sibilance.

casting.role: Kobold Scout / Mischievous Goblin
casting.direction: Deliver lines with rapid, breathy urgency and scheming excitement.

casting.role: Frenetic Alien Salvager
casting.direction: Haggle rapidly with a sharp, squeaky tone and intense nervous pacing.

casting.role: Cursed Doll / Impish Familiar
casting.direction: Emphasize the throat constriction and raspy giggles to create an unsettling yet comical vibe.

nerubian.one_sentence_impression: A deep, menacing, guttural bass voice with a heavy raspy resonance and an intimidating, deliberate delivery.
nerubian.detailed_sentence: This voice sits in an extremely low chest register marked by intense throat rasp and dark rumble, delivering each word with slow, authoritative gravity that finishes with a heavy, beastly exhale.
nerubian.perceived_age: Middle-aged to elder (~45-60), sounding like an experienced, formidable commander or ancient creature.
nerubian.register: Extremely low bass register with limited pitch movement, maintaining a steady, grave, monotone cadence.

timbre_profile.summary: Extremely dark and gravelly bass voice dominated by heavy throat rasp and deep chest resonance.

nerubian.distinctive_features: Slow deliberate pacing, heavy vocal fry and guttural throat growl, menacingly authoritative presence, and a signature wet beastly exhale/snort at the end of phrases.

casting.role: Orc warlord or demonic chieftain

casting.role: Alien conqueror or hulking subterranean creature

casting.role: Ancient eldritch demon or dungeon boss

gargoyle.one_sentence_impression: A harsh, gravelly, and deeply guttural creature voice that speaks in a low, menacing rasp.
gargoyle.detailed_sentence: This voice features an extreme amount of throat friction and dry gravelly rasp, delivering low-pitched, deliberate, and sinister utterances with an ominous, breathy exhale.
gargoyle.perceived_age: Elderly / Ancient (60+ or timeless), suggested by the heavily worn, dry rasp and slow, menacing delivery.
gargoyle.register: Low register with a slow, near-monotone pitch contour and deliberate pauses.

timbre_profile.summary: Dominantly throaty and intensely rough, featuring a dark, dry, gravelly texture.

gargoyle.distinctive_features: Slow, measured cadence with deliberate chunking; extreme throat growl and raspy friction; dominant and sinister mood with audible, breathy exhales on trailing words.

casting.role: Stone gargoyle sentinel or ancient shadow fiend

casting.role: Possessed demon or subterranean monster

casting.role: Hostile alien warlord or corrupted mutant

pandaren.one_sentence_impression: A deep, gravelly male voice with warm chest resonance and a slow, measured cadence that sounds like a seasoned wanderer or wise elder.
pandaren.detailed_sentence: This mature male voice features a low-mid pitch anchor, rich throatiness, and a gentle gravelly texture that delivers lines with relaxed, deliberate pacing and grounded authority.
pandaren.perceived_age: Middle-aged to elderly (~55-65), indicated by the vocal gravel, relaxed cadence, and rich chest resonance.
pandaren.register: Low-to-mid register with steady pitch contour and calm, rhythmic cadence.

timbre_profile.summary: Deep, chest-dominant tone with warm vocal grit and a rounded, dark finish.

pandaren.distinctive_features: Deliberate, rhythmic pacing with extended vowel holds; noticeable throat rasp and chest resonance; calm, reassuring, and weathered tone.

casting.role: Wandering monk or venerable tavern keeper

casting.role: Seasoned caravan leader or trade guild master

casting.role: Retired starship captain or alien ambassador

wolf.one_sentence_impression: A deep, rasping creature respiratory sound featuring heavy inhales and hushed, dark exhales.
wolf.detailed_sentence: This non-verbal voice effect produces a low, dry, and intensely raspy inhalation followed by a long, hollow, dark exhaled hiss that sounds like a sinister monster or predatory beast lurking in the shadows.
wolf.perceived_age: Ageless / Mature, evoking an ancient or fully-grown monster or beast.
wolf.register: Low register with minimal tonal pitch, consisting primarily of low-frequency airflow and quiet, rhythmic breathing motion.

timbre_profile.summary: Dark, gritty, and breath-heavy with prominent throat rasp and deep hollow chest resonance.

wolf.distinctive_features: Pronounced atmospheric inhalation and exhaled air flow, scratchy throat texture, air-heavy friction, and an ominous, predatory rhythm.

casting.role: Lurking shadow wolf or demonic beast

casting.role: Ominous presence in a haunted forest

gnome.one_sentence_impression: A high-pitched, raspy, and energetic voice with a pinched, theatrical cadence that sounds like a mischievous small fantasy creature.
gnome.detailed_sentence: Characterized by its constricted throaty rasp, high pitch placement, and lively melodic jumps, this voice produces a bright, squeaky, and theatrical tone reminiscent of an eccentric small creature or eager old inventor.
gnome.perceived_age: Middle-aged to elderly (~50-70), suggested by the raspy, weathered texture despite the elevated pitch.
gnome.register: High register with dynamic, animated pitch movement and expressive, sing-song cadence.

timbre_profile.summary: Bright and constricted high-register voice featuring a prominent throaty rasp and minimal chest resonance.

gnome.distinctive_features: Fast, bouncy pacing with sharp pitch spikes, constricted back-of-throat resonance, raspy vocal grit, and an eager, eccentric delivery.

casting.role: Eccentric Gnome Inventor or Mischievous Goblin

casting.role: Hyperactive Alien Trader or Scavenger

draenei.register: Low to mid-low pitch with steady, controlled intonation and minimal pitch variance.

timbre_profile.summary: Deep, chest-dominant resonance balanced by a subtle throaty warmth and a smooth, weathered texture.

draenei.distinctive_features: Deliberate, rhythmic pacing with clear pauses between phrases; subtle Eastern European or fantasy-styled accentuation; commanding yet serene presence.

abomination.perceived_age: Elderly / Ancient (60+), suggested by the weathered, gravelly tone and ponderous speech rhythm.
abomination.register: Extremely low bass with minimal pitch variance and a steady, ominous monotone.

abomination.distinctive_features: Slow, rhythmic pacing with extended pauses; dominant and terrifying tone; gravelly sub-bass rumble on every syllable.

chromie.perceived_age: Child or ageless sprite (~7-12), due to the extremely high pitch, light vocal weight, and youthful resonance.
chromie.register: High register with frequent melodic pitch sweeps and expressive, bouncy intonation.

timbre_profile.summary: Bright, squeaky, and head-dominant voice with virtually no chest resonance and a high, clear falsetto placement.

chromie.distinctive_features: High squeaky head voice, bouncy rhythmic pacing, sharp clear sibilance, and an eager, friendly delivery style.
